attrs.evidence: World row L-COORD-1 (4/4): a derivation calling addGround mid-pass is refused with maintainer-reentrancy-refused and leaves no def and no after-map entry; assigning this.world is refused by the instance freeze so the pass ABORTS with a receipt instead of unlocking the wrong world and bricking the authoritative one; instance and prototype sealer overrides and setPrototypeOf all throw, and the pass seals a real 64-char pass_id; a nested pass refuses. The pre-fix witnesses are frozen RED in probe_maintainer_9d_repro.mjs against World 0.7.1, where three of the audit's four reproduced. grid_check v2.14 scans for the guard constructs; negative cases coordinator-freeze-stripped, coordinator-proto-freeze-stripped and coordinator-reentrancy-stripped die on distinct diagnostics.
attrs.statement: The object HOLDING the maintenance lock is itself an authority surface and must be confined like the one it locks. The Maintainer's root reference and methods are not reassignable (instance and prototype frozen, setPrototypeOf refused), and registration is refused re-entrantly for the duration of a pass. Its defs/state maps stay mutable BY DESIGN: the external-ingest position already exists and is modelled by register(); the attack closed here is not that a map can be written but that it could be written from inside a transaction.
